questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: At the highest point of its path, the velocity of a projectile launched at an angle θ with speed u is:
questions.explanation: The vertical component becomes zero at the top but the horizontal component is unaffected by gravity, so the speed there is u cos θ.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 3: Motion in a Plane

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A Wheatstone bridge with arms P, Q, R and S is balanced when:
questions.explanation: At balance no current passes through the galvanometer, and applying Kirchhoff's loop rule gives P/Q = R/S. The metre bridge works on this principle.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The binding energy per nucleon is maximum for nuclei of mass number close to:
questions.explanation: The curve peaks near A = 56, around iron, so iron group nuclei are the most stable. Lighter nuclei release energy by fusion and heavier ones by fission.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The energy of an electron in the nth orbit of a hydrogen atom is -13.6/n² eV. The energy needed to remove the electron completely from the ground state is:
questions.explanation: Ionisation means taking the electron from n = 1 to n = infinity, where energy is zero, so the energy supplied must be 0 - (-13.6) = 13.6 eV.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 2: Structure of Atom

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The complexes [Co(NH₃)₅Br]SO₄ and [Co(NH₃)₅SO₄]Br are an example of:
questions.explanation: The two compounds exchange an ion between the coordination sphere and the ionisation sphere, so they give different ions in solution and different precipitation tests.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Among the following carboxylic acids, the strongest in aqueous solution is:
questions.explanation: Formic acid has no electron releasing alkyl group, so its carboxylate ion is least destabilised. Adding or branching alkyl groups lowers acidity further.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 8: Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The widely accepted fluid mosaic model of the plasma membrane was proposed by:
questions.explanation: Singer and Nicolson described the membrane in 1972 as a lipid bilayer with proteins floating in it, which explains its quasi-fluid nature and lateral movement.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 8: Cell: The Unit of Life

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Down's syndrome in humans is caused by:
questions.explanation: An extra copy of chromosome 21 gives 47 chromosomes and results from failure of chromosomes to separate during gamete formation.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 4: Principles of Inheritance and Variation

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which of the following does NOT promote the clotting of blood?
questions.explanation: Heparin is a natural anticoagulant that prevents clotting inside intact vessels; the other three are essential parts of the clotting cascade.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 15: Body Fluids and Circulation

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: According to NCERT, medical termination of pregnancy is considered relatively safe when carried out up to:
questions.explanation: MTP during the first trimester, up to twelve weeks, is relatively safe; later terminations carry much higher risk and need stricter medical conditions.
